title: Tackling Slipagge on Cardano: MAYZ Trustless OTC Smart Contract

ms.promise:
Create a detailed project plan including:
・Research report on liquidity challenges in the Cardano ecosystem.
・Functional documentation of smart contracts, their basic architecture and potential applications. Outlining the Trustless OTC Smart Contract concept, architecture, and potential applications. (By basic architecture we mean an overview of the protocol architecture)
ms.criteria:
・Project Plan document detailed and public. Including a liquidity research report completed and the functional technical documentation detailed.
・Documents are clear, understandable to all readers, and freely and publicly accessible.
ms.report:
Hello reviewers!
Thank you for the comments. We appreciate your thorough review and feedback. We recognize that some aspects of the smart contract implementation details were not fully elaborated in this milestone as we focused on establishing the foundational research and high-level architecture. Future milestones will go deeper into the technical details.
To clarify some points: 
・Could you provide detailed description of smart contract functions: input parameters, output, state changes for functionalities like token exchange and NFT minting?

Yes, that is the next milestone: 
 “Smart contracts detailed architecture diagram illustrating components and their interactions. Documentation with the detailed architecture of smart contracts, a definition of parameters of each contract, their redeemers, and datums. GitHub repository: a public repository containing the initial source code.”
・What will be the features to handle an error like “token redemption fail” or a security issue like “unauthorized redemption”?

It will be added; the mechanism is the NFT check and burn. It does not need any particular feature.
・How will this trustless OTC smart contract interact with existing MAYZ smart contracts- is there any dependency?

No Dependencies to any smart contract. Just use the fungible token MAYZ. 
・How will your trustless OTC smart contract interact with other smart contracts or external systems (like NFT marketplaces or token standards). You have mentioned token standards and how OTC solutions work in the liquidity challenge report (page 1 &2) but this external interface information is needed.

The smart contract will not interact with any other smart contract. Any user can list an asset in a marketplace.
